regime: Equities Chop Under Flipped Stops, Commodities Bid (Crude Leads, Gold Repairs)
summary: Same script as yesterday, and crude still runs the show. NQ chopped and closed a touch lower at 29,460, ES eased to 7,648, and both are stuck under the trend stops that flipped down Friday. The one change was gold. December bounced 1.1 percent to 4,447, flipped its short term trend back up, and tagged 4,477 before fading. Crude kept leading, up another 2.5 percent to 96.66 and above a rising stop for a second day. VIX firmed again to 16.46 but stayed low, so the tape is still rotating, not panicking.
psychology: Two quiet days in the index can bait you into forcing a trade. Do not. NQ dropped more than 200 points this morning to 29,358, then took it all back to close near the middle. If you shorted the flush you got squeezed, and if you chased the bounce you gave it back. The market is coiling under a stop with PPI tomorrow and CPI Friday. When you do not have a clear edge and the calendar is about to move price, the strong play is smaller size or the sidelines. Let the number print, then trade the reaction you can see.

event.nqReaction: NQ broke up out of a tight opening range, failed, flushed to 29,358, then recovered to close flat at 29,460, still below its falling stop.
event.crossAsset: Crude up 2.5 percent to 96.66 and leading a second day. December gold up 1.1 percent to 4,447 and flipped its trend up. VIX 16.46, up 4.71 percent but still low. A rotational, not risk driven, tape.

risk.sizing: Keep index size reduced. NQ and ES are still choppy and below their falling stops, so the short term index trend is not up. Do not chase the range in either direction. The trending longs are crude, above a rising 94.95 stop, and now December gold, which flipped above a rising 4,418 stop today. Both can be managed against those stops, gold with respect that it just gave back the day's gains.
risk.openRisk: For the indices the falling stops are the line. MNQ back above 29,585 or MES above 7,678 on two hourly closes turns the short term trend up. Below, MNQ 29,358 then the 29,000 psych, and MES 7,629 then 7,600, are the downside references. December gold stays constructive above 4,418 and works on reclaiming 4,450. Crude stays long above 94.95 and 95.
risk.note: Rising event risk into two inflation prints: August PPI Thursday September 10 and August CPI Friday September 11, both 8:30 ET, with the Fed the following week. Keep size sensible and mind prop news blackout rules around both releases. Not financial advice.

fullReport.html:
NQ printed a tight opening range: high 29,506, low 29,417, a 89.5 point band, about half of Tuesday's width. Price broke UP out of the range at 13:50 UTC, ran to a 29,594 high, then failed and came back into the range, closing 29,460 right at NYVWAP 29,464. The upside break did not hold and price fell back inside the range, a Back Into Range from the top.
